name: Vincent Tong
bio: Vincent Tong (born May 2, 1980) is a Canadian actor, voice actor and director. His voice roles include Gene Khan / The Mandarin in Iron Man: Armored Adventures, Toro in Sushi Pack, Henry in Kid vs. Kat, Daniel in Voltron Force, Kai in Ninjago as well as Jestro in Nexo Knights. He also voiced Euden in Dragalia Lost before being replaced by Victor Hunter.
